libreria.vuota: No characters yet. Import one from the builder.
import.incollaQui: Paste the JSON or the link
qr.istruzioni: Point the camera at the QR printed by the builder and keep it inside the frame. As soon as I read it, the character lands in your library.
qr.sospesa: Camera off: the app went to the background. Tap «Resume» to start framing again.
qr.permessoNegato: I don't have permission to use the camera. You can grant it again from your browser settings — the icon next to the address — then tap «Try again».
qr.nessunaTelecamera: I can't find any camera on this device. Import the character from a file, from pasted JSON, or from a share link.
qr.contestoInsicuro: The camera only works over a secure connection: open the app from its https address (or from localhost) and try again. For now use a file, pasted JSON, or a link.
qr.telecameraOccupata: The camera is already in use by another app. Close it and tap «Try again».
qr.errore: I can't turn the camera on. Tap «Try again», or import from a file, pasted JSON, or a link.
qr.nienteDaLeggere: Still nothing. Move closer, hold steady, and check that the whole QR is inside the frame and well lit.
qr.nonUnPersonaggio: This code is not a character.
qr.senzaRegistro: I can't read the pack registry: without it I can't tell whether this character is playable. Try again once you're back online.
dadi.nessunTiro: No rolls yet. Tap a die.
prove.naturale20: Natural 20 (not an automatic success on checks)
errata.incapacitato: The official Italian SRD 5.2.1 opens this entry with “paralyzed”; the English original says “incapacitated”. The text above is reproduced verbatim.
magia.senzaSlotAffatto: No free slots. You need a rest.
opz.edizioneNota: Looking at the other edition doesn't convert the character: slots, DCs and levelling stay theirs.
opz.schermoSveglioNota: While the app is open the screen won't sleep. It uses battery, and not every browser allows it.
opz.vibrazioneNota: A short buzz when the dice settle, with a distinct pattern for a natural 20 and a natural 1. Not available on iPhone.
opz.esportaNota: One file with every character and their play state.
opz.azzeraNota: Removes characters, rolls and settings from this device. There is no undo.
opz.azzeraConferma: Erase everything? There is no undo.
opz.privacy: Nothing leaves this device: no account, no server, no tracking.
opz.clubNota: An app by the gaming club of Faenza.
priv.senzaTestoNonLibero: The text is not included: this is not SRD material. You need the book to play it.
priv.senzaTesto: The text is not in this edition's SRD.
prove.non20: On checks it is not an automatic success.
